# MathJax 4.1.3

Locally hosted browser files from the official npm packages `mathjax@4.1.3`
and `@mathjax/mathjax-tex-font@4.1.3` (Apache-2.0; see LICENSE).

The combined `tex-mml-svg-mathjax-tex.js` bundle renders TeX as SVG with the
Computer Modern TeX font. TeX extensions, alternate CHTML output/fonts, and
accessibility speech resources are included for lazy loading from this directory.
No npm install or CDN connection is needed by the deployed page.

Configuration and the Markdown math extension live in ../../../math.js.
